description:
# StairSeat 🪑

**Take a seat.** Right-click any stair and your player sits down on it.
Perfect for lobbies, roleplay, cafés and spawn builds. Jump to stand back up.

![StairSeat](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NaySurGithub/StairSeat/main/.jarbage/icon.png "StairSeat")

## Features

- 🪑 Sit on **every** stair, including new ones — no list to keep up to date
- 🦘 Jump to stand up, just like getting off a horse
- 👥 One player per stair, others get a "this seat is used" message
- 🧱 Break the stair and whoever sits on it stands up
- 🔀 Players can turn sitting on or off for themselves with `/sit`
- 🧹 Nothing is saved in your world — no ghost entities after a restart

## Install

1. Put `StairSeat-x.y.z.jar` in your `plugins/` folder.
2. Restart the server. Done!

## Config

Everything is in `plugins/StairSeat/config.yml`:

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `worlds` | all worlds | Worlds where players can sit. Empty = everywhere. |
| `default-toggle-sit` | `true` | Whether sitting is on by default. If `false`, players turn it on with `/sit`. |
| `allow-seat-high-height` | `true` | Allow sitting on a stair higher than your feet. |
| `allow-seat-upsidedown` | `false` | Allow sitting on upside-down stairs. |
| `stand-up-when-break-block` | `true` | Stand the player up when their stair is broken. |
| `disable-damage-when-sit` | `false` | Seated players take no damage. |
| `enable-check-up-block` | `false` | Only allow sitting when there is air above the stair. |
| `allow-only-right-click` | `true` | Set to `false` to also sit with a left click. |
| `disabled-stairs` | none | Stairs you can't sit on, e.g. `minecraft:oak_stairs`. |
| `seat-y-offset` | `0.0` | Move the seat up or down if players look too high or too low. |
| `send-tip-when-sit` | `Tap jump to exit the seat` | Tip shown when sitting. `@b` `@x` `@y` `@z` are replaced. |
| `try-to-sit-already-inuse` | `This seat is used by @p` | Message when the seat is taken. `@p` `@b` are replaced. |
| `toggle-on-message` / `toggle-off-message` | — | Messages of `/sit`. |

Sneak while clicking a stair to place blocks on it without sitting down.

## Commands

| Command | Who | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/sit` | `stairseat.toggle` (everyone) | Turn sitting on stairs on or off for yourself |

## For developers

```java
StairSeatPlugin stairSeat = (StairSeatPlugin) server.getPluginManager().getPlugin("StairSeat");
boolean sitting = stairSeat.isSitting(player);
```

## Requirements

PowerNukkitX 3.0.0+ · Java 21

## Building

```bash
./gradlew build
```
